title: Good Morning, and a Rule That Declines to Fire
label: ch:zh-zaoshang
canDo: I can write 早 and 上, greet someone with 早上好, hear a neutral-tone syllable as the absence of a tone mark rather than a mistake, and say why the third-tone rule changes 你好 but leaves 早上好 alone.

payoff.summary: The first exchange where the reader chooses between two correct greetings rather than reciting the only one available -- and the first place all three tone behaviours in the track line up side by side, one moving and two declining to.
